name: Sangar: a horseshoe of piled stones
about: Made by tools/battle-models/med/scenery.py. Metres; x east, y right, z up from the ground at the foot. Scenery: nothing moves but what the wind moves (`sway`, 0 to 1 point by point: how far the wind moves that point; the game bends by it). near: close; mid: about a quarter of near; far: the plain shape for the whole view. Paints: 0 rock_dark, 1 rock, 2 rock_pale, 3 sand
opens: to -x: the back of the horseshoe is open; turn it to face the enemy's way
